description: Fixed split of the 3000 base geometries, shared by every physics, model and training seed. Porosity (#pore cells - 64*20)/(64*128) of the base geometry is sorted into 15 equal-count bins; 20 test geometries per bin are drawn with numpy default_rng(27), then 20 validation geometries per bin from the remaining ones with default_rng(2027). The listed identifiers are authoritative; every script reads them from this file.
velocity_samples_note: Velocity sample indices (idx = base + 3000*Re_group) in the order used for training and evaluation (the order enters the mini-batch shuffling).
adsorption_samples_note: Irreversible-adsorption samples: for every base (ascending) the 9 (Da, Pe) conditions, idx = base + 3000*k, k = 0..8.
monod_samples_note: Monod samples (base, group, t) in training order: splits/monod_samples.npz.
